meta.note: Where a hidden path or secret passage really runs in the tile picture, when it is not the straight line between its two clearings. mid = the middle of the printed passage, in the same tile-normalised units as artpos.json (x -1..1 across the tile, y -0.866..0.866); the passage is drawn as a curve through it. Measured by eye on the pictures. Paths not listed here are drawn straight.
